hyps.why: Replacing conv3x3 with conv1x1 loses capacity, whereas replacing pool, skip or none with conv1x1 is a gain.
An identity shortcut on the direct edge already eases optimization, so a conv on edge 5 adds less.
Reviving a dead edge into a conv3x3 gains more than swapping a pool or skip for it.
A conv on edge 0 builds features at node 1 that edge 4 can refine into a deeper path to the output.
If edge 0 is none, node 1 is disconnected and the edit on edge 4 has no input to act on.
Adding a direct identity path where none existed gains, while replacing a conv is a loss.
When edge 1 is none, edge 0 is node 2's only source, so removing it can sever much of the cell.
Removing the direct edge hurts more when edge 4 gives no alternative path to the output.
Removing edge 5 hurts more when the direct edge 3 is absent and redundancy is lost.
Downgrading a conv3x3 to conv1x1 on the direct edge loses capacity, unlike upgrading from pool, skip or none.
